description: This file contains implementation of Direction Finding (DF) features for Bluetooth controller, including initialization, reset, antenna management, CTE (Constant Tone Extension) transmission and reception, and synchronization configuration.

methods.name: lll_df_init
methods.description: Initializes Direction Finding features, configuring antenna switching GPIOs if enabled, and performs reset.

methods.name: lll_df_reset
methods.description: Resets Direction Finding configuration to default state.

methods.name: lll_df_ant_num_get
methods.description: Returns the number of available antennas as provided by hardware via devicetree.

methods.name: lll_df_cte_tx_enable
methods.description: Enables transmission of Constant Tone Extension (CTE) for periodic advertising, configuring CTE type, length, and antenna switch pattern.

methods.name: lll_df_sync_cfg_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new synchronization configuration buffer and returns a pointer to it.

methods.name: lll_df_sync_cfg_latest_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest synchronization configuration, marking it as used.

methods.name: lll_df_conf_cte_rx_enable
methods.description: Configures reception of CTE, setting antenna switch pattern and IQ data packet parameters.

methods.name: lll_df_conf_cte_info_parsing_enable
methods.description: Prepares radio for parsing CTE info in received PDUs, disabling IQ sampling storage.

methods.name: lll_df_cte_tx_configure
methods.description: Configures CTE transmission parameters based on CTE type and antenna pattern.

methods.name: lll_df_cte_tx_disable
methods.description: Disables CTE transmission and resets radio configuration.
